title: Taylor Swift fans spot 'serendipitous' link between star's new album release and iconic film - NewsBreak
text: Taylor Swift's fans are buzzing with excitement as they've noticed a fun coincidence between the release date of her new album and a beloved Hollywood tradition. The Grammy Award-winning songstress has officially announced Oct. 3 as the drop date for her highly anticipated album, The Life of a Showgirl. In a post on X , formerly known as Twitter , she wrote: "And, baby, that's show business for you. New album, The Life of a Showgirl. Out October 3 Album Producers: Max Martin, Shellback, and Taylor Swift ." After getting a sneak peek at the album cover and tracklist, fans quickly realized that the chosen date is also celebrated by fans of the hit 2004 comedy film Mean Girls, starring Lindsay Lohan and Rachel McAdams. Every year, die-hard fans of the movie mark this date by donning pink outfits, quoting memorable lines from the film, and participating in other related activities. READ MORE: Amy Bradley case finally sees breakthrough after 'verifiable' 2016 sighting READ MORE: MSNBC interrupted by Donald Trump's outburst over 'losing support' due to Epstein files Interestingly, there seems to be a significant overlap between Mean Girls enthusiasts and Swifties, leading to a wave of joyous reactions to the serendipitous coincidence. On X, one fan humorously referenced a famous line from the film, saying, "he asked me what day is taylor dropping her album? october 3rd i said (or however that scene in the original Mean Girls goes idk)." Another excited fan wrote, "Not TayBae releasing her next album on Mean Girls Day. This woman is after my heart." A third chimed in with, "taylor's album on mean girls day. there is something truly serendipitous about this. "October 3 being Mean Girls day and The Life of a Showgirl release day will never not be iconic," a fourth fan declared. Alongside revealing the date, she also unveiled the album artwork, which shows Taylor donning a crystal-adorned bustier while her body is immersed in water, with only her face emerging above the surface. A second image disclosed the titles of the 12 tracks that will feature on the record. Sabrina Carpenter, who served as opening act for the pop star on her legendary Eras tour, stands as the sole additional artist credited as a collaborator. One supporter also highlighted how the connection ties back to Sabrina's Broadway premiere in the Mean Girls musical in March of 2020. They posted, "sabrina being in mean girls on bway, the release date being oct 3, ugh it really is my new favourite day."
